tools.name: find_color
tools.description: Look up traditional colors by name and get hex/RGB with sources. Accepts Japanese kanji (浅葱色), reading in hiragana or katakana (あさぎいろ), English (Asagi, Prussian Blue), with or without 色. Exact name matches come first.

tools.name: nearest_colors
tools.description: Given a hex code, return the closest traditional colors by CIEDE2000 color difference (delta_e). Use it to answer "what is this color called in Japanese tradition?".

tools.name: list_colors
tools.description: List colors filtered by culture, category (e.g. 青系, 赤系), era (e.g. 平安, 江戸) or tag. At most 50 per call.

tools.name: list_cultures
tools.description: List the cultures covered, with color counts and categories.
